segments.text: My question will focus on DICT's follow-through,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: as well as the security of the META platform.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: The DICT also announced an agreement with META on online scams,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: particularly those occurring through Facebook and other META platforms.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: The DICT announced an agreement with META as early as February 2026,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: covering fake investment schemes, phishing, digital fraud, online scams, and deep fakes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: What does the agreement actually entail, Mr. Speaker?

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: So, Madam Speaker, the agreement that was being referred to is separate from the MOA that they're currently working on.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: And to update my colleague, because of the urgency,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: as of yesterday, the DICT and CICC have already started their technical working group with META

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: to be able to address the concerns of our constituents with regards to these matters.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: However, on the status of the TWG,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: because they're just about to start,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: they're only doing role assignments and immediate target setting.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: But as the days go on, we'll see immediate action from the relevant agencies, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: By the way, how many, as far as Facebook account,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: do they have Facebook or the META as an office here in the Philippines?

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I would like to confirm that Facebook does have a physical office here in the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: However, we don't have jurisdiction over them, Madam Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: dahil marketing office lang po ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, in short, Madam Speaker, wala talaga silang office, only marketing arm.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, what I'm trying to say, do they have a country manager here in the Philippines?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And how many employees do they employ?

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: There's only a handful of employees here in the Philippines, Madam Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: and they don't have an official country manager for the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: But I would like to assure my colleague that one of the terms that,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: the two of the terms that are being considered in this technical working group

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: is one, that they do have a physical office here in the Philippines,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: a corporate office here in the Philippines,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: that they require the national ID already for users of META here in the Philippines.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: I want to point that out, that Brazil has already implemented such a system

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Madam Speaker, what I'm trying to say, do they have office?

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Madam Speaker, we don't have jurisdiction.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Considering that the Philippines is the fifth largest population on META,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: that META does not have an actual country manager and a real office here in the Philippines,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: considering the amount of capital that this country provides META through its engagement on the platform.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: So, I agree with my colleague here.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: This is a priority for us.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Madam Speaker, the distinguished sponsor mentioned a while ago that we are,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: the fifth largest users of META.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Imagine, the entire, sa buong mundo, pang lima tayo,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: and we're only, what, 120 million Filipinos compared to other countries,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: But again, so we're being ignored.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: I'm not trying to blame the ICT, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: We keep on making their businesses.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: But in return, hindi mo lang tayo mapansin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Not even as office here in the Philippines, hindi maibigay sa atin.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And they have to follow the Philippine laws, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: So, my next question, ano po ang ginawa ng DICT?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Did you persuade them na magtayo kayo sa opisina?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Opisina, that you have a country manager,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: that you have the organizational structure that will look into sa mga scammers?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Ang dami nang lumalabas, kawawa ang ating mga kababayan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Well, the two non-negotiables, Madam Speaker,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: are one, that they open an actual office here in the Philippines

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: so that they can be held accountable.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: And two, Madam Speaker, again, for the sake of accountability and protection on social media,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: the requirement of national ID in order to create or maintain your account on the META platform,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: So, these are steps that are being taken.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: To be fair to META, META seems open to these requirements and have even cited other countries in which they had similar requirements and acted on it.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: So we're moving in that direction and the results of this technical working group that just started, hopefully we'll be able to see it within the next few months.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Again, Madam Speaker, Distinguished Sponsor, the concern is that DICT has several programs, publicized partnerships and coordination mechanisms, but we know, but we don't have visibility of the result of those initiatives.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: What system does DICT currently have to ensure that actions announced by the department are actually monitored through implementation?

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I want to share with my colleague here and all the members of Congress that there is actual action that DICT is taking to hold META accountable.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: And what I have here in my hand, Madam Speaker, is a copy of several documents that have been submitted to the Office of the Solicitor General to possibly build up a case against META for abuses that take place on their platform,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: So in this, we have in Annex A, a draft of a civil complaint, which was prepared by the DICT.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: In Annex B, there is a formal request drawing from global litigation precedents in Brazil, New Mexico, and Los Angeles that recognize platforms as active participants rather than passive intermediaries of actions taken on their platform.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: All the evidence and documentation of abuse, that's OSAEC, CSAEM, financial fraud, online debt harassment, illegal gambling,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: records of platform knowledge and inaction is also included in this document in Annex C.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: In Annex D, the National Privacy Commission asserted its regulatory jurisdiction over META

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: in relation to the processing of personal data for AI-generated content and functionalities.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: And the NTC submitted its legal position paper on a test case for courts to propose action to be taken against Facebook in Annex E.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: So the DICT and its attached agencies aren't just sitting around waiting for something to happen.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: They've already prepared the necessary evidence, documents,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: and potential cases to hold META accountable should they not work together with our government.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: So I would like to request the assistance of a page to pass a copy of this to my colleague

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: so that my colleague would be able to go over the document.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Madam Speaker, what if I file a House resolution in aid of legislation and I will summon the DICT

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: and who will be the representatives from META?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Kali mag-file ako ng House resolution with regard to what happened to Zamboanga massacre.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: And of course, yung mga kanilang violation.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Sino ang pupunta rito from META?

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: From the DICT, they themselves wrote directly to Mark Zuckerberg to ask him to confront these issues which we are facing.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Madam Speaker, I don't think the founder, Mark Zuckerberg, will come here.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Para sa atin, ganito lang tayo sa kanya.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: They make a lot of money through Facebook.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Alam naman nila na puri karamihan is...

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: I'm not saying the whole thing, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Myself, I don't have Facebook account, no?

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Kasi alam ko maraming kalokohan dyan, pero maraming gumagamit at karamihan sa ating mga kababayan

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: ay kumikita naman dyan, in fairness.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: But again, we're talking about responsibility.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: We're talking about yung kailangan nila maging, ano sila rito, accountable.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Yan po ang kailangan natin, Madam Speaker.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Madam Speaker, though Mark Zuckerberg himself never showed up in countries like Brazil and others,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: they did send legal representation to confront the issues in other countries.

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Kung magkaroon po tayo ng isang...

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: Kung magkaroon po tayo ng isang House Resolution investigating this,

segments.speaker: Rep. Brian Poe
segments.text: kailangan na kailangan magpadala ng representation ang META to confront these valid issues from the House of Representatives.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: the issue then is not the absence of initiatives,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: but whether the ICT has sufficient mechanisms to monitor implementation and measure actual results.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: I appreciate the responses of the Department,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: However, I remain concerned that there is still insufficient information before this body

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: regarding the actual outcomes of the ICT's anti-scam initiatives.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: The Department has entered into agreement, established reporting mechanisms,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: and coordinated with private platforms and law enforcement agency.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: this Committee must also be able to determine what happened after those actions were initiated.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: it is difficult for Congress to properly assess whether the resources being requested are producing the intended outcomes.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: until those matters are a satisfactory address,

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: and the Department can present measurables, deliverables.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: Madam Speaker, it pains me, but I have no choice.

segments.speaker: Rep. Presley C. De Jesus
segments.text: I move that for consideration of the budget of the Department of Information and Communication Technology be deferred.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: At that same time, pagbibigay ng mga karagdagang skills to upskill our workforce in the future.

segments.text: Kaya sa aking mga kasamahan, I'm sure ito po ay napakahalaga.

segments.text: para ma-implement ngayong 2026 and moving forward hanggang 2027 para siguraduhin natin na ang ating mga workers, hindi lamang sa Metro Manila bagkos sa buong Pilipinas, ay magkaroon ng kahit papaano ay social protection at meron silang masasandalan pagdating ng oras ng kinakailangan. segments.text: Maraming salamat po, Madam Speaker, at sa ating kaibigan, ang kagalang-galang na Romel Angara, sponsor po ng budget ng Department of Labor and Employment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ang mandato ng Department of Labor and Employment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Ito ay ipagtanggol at itaguyod ang karapatan ng mga manggagawa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: Diyan pa lamang po, Mr. Sponsor, Madam Speaker, napakabigat na na responsibilidad ang nakaatang sa Department of Labor and Employment.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: ang malaking tanong ng mga manggagawa,

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: bakit sa hinihinging budget ng Department of Labor and Employment,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Thank you for that, Madam Speaker, Distinguished Colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: pag dinisek mo po yung ating pondo ng Office of the Secretary,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: kasi pagdating po, doon lang po ilalagak yan.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Simple as that, Madam Speaker and ating Distinguished Colleague.

segments.speaker: Rep. Elijah Rumbaoa San Fernando
segments.text: binibigyang matwid ngayon ng Department of Labor and Employment,

segments.text: na mahigit kalahati ng budget na hinihingi ng DOLE for the Office of the Secretary,

segments.text: ay proteksyonan, ipagtanggol, at itaguyod ang karapatan ng mga manggagawa.

segments.text: Pero you also have to understand, Madam Speaker, Distinguished Colleague,

segments.text: sa ating bansa ng Pilipinas, unfortunately,

segments.text: nagkaroon tayo ng mga natural disasters.

segments.text: Alam mo, pag nangyari ito, even the local governments,

segments.text: I came from the local government,

segments.text: para pang salba sa ating mga naaksidente, binagyo, so on and so forth.

segments.text: Even pag nagkaroon ng programa para sa ating transport group,

segments.text: My last line of questioning, Madam Speaker, good sponsor, is in relation po sa tinanong din po natin sa TESDA,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: before I directly answer your question, let me read first the status of the AI upskilling.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: One, TESDA is calling up its AI skills programs in line with the National AI Upskilling Roadmap

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: TESDA has already allocated 53,442 scholarship slots for AI and digital-related skills

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: The context would be that TESDA recognizes the need to adopt our workforce with AI.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Estimates vary but different analysis place the number of jobs that will be affected by AI

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: And the National AI Upskilling Roadmap segmentizes the labor force into three clusters

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: that represent three A's in AI.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: This entails different courses from foundational competencies and AI literacy

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: to more specialized and advanced courses that will equip Filipinos with skills

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: not only to consume but also to build AI systems.

segments.text: That's the reason na ang unchallenged po sa atin ngayon,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Maraming salamat, Madam Speaker. Magandang umaga po. Ginoong sponsor at sa buong DOLE family.

segments.text: At siyempre kasama dyan, special mention, ang paborito nating TESDA.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: At pangunahin dito yung usapin ng workers' rights and welfare.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: But the irony is not lost on me. Marami po mga manggagawa tayo dito sa loob ng Kongreso, sa ating mga opisina, at mismo po sa DOLE, ang Puyat na ngayong araw na ito.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: And while naniniwala tayo na dapat walang tulugan para sa transparency and accountability,

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: sa dulo po dapat huwag din nating pabayaan ang kapakanan ng ating mga manggagawa.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Let me begin with a humble appeal to the leadership of the House of Representatives.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Natiyakin po natin yung kapakanan, kalusugan ng ating mga manggagawa, ang kanilang well-being.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Hindi po talaga makatarungan ang ganitong uri ng diskurso sa ganitong alangan ng oras na ng madaling araw.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: And the irony of it all, we're talking about workers' rights and welfare now.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Balik lang po ako, Madam Speaker, ginaong sponsor doon sa kaninang exchange between the good sponsor and Representative Elly tungkol po sa nangyaring September 10 NWPC meeting.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Allegedly, may nangyaring NWPC meeting noong September 10. At nabanggit din po kanina na isang dahilan kaya po lumipat ng kwarto ay dahil daw po mayroong disruption.

segments.speaker: Rep. Percival "Perci" Cendaña
segments.text: Can the good sponsor elaborate further on this claim about disruptions or disruptors?

segments.text: Madam Speaker, distinguished colleague, well, the process sa wage setting, Madam Speaker, distinguished colleague, there's a reason na bakit po may proseso.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: One, nabanggit po natin leading to the September 10, was that there was already a public hearing.

segments.text: Or consultation, but technically the right word is public hearing. September 2 po yan.

segments.text: Na marami po yung, we have pictures and videos na lahat naman po doon ay imbitado.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Pertaining doon po sa sinasabing September 10, tandaan po ninyo, yung ito na po ay nagpapatukoy doon sa Wage Order No. 28 na dapat ay affirmation.

segments.text: And for the record, sabi ko nga po kanina, Madam Speaker, distinguished colleague, the reason of being wage na ito po ay ating nabanggit.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Sapagkat, yung mga miyembro dapat ng ating na kung saan na, nasa affirmation doon sa ating wage order, ay dapat nandun na po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: Nandun din yun sa binanggit ko na yung labor sector. Unfortunately, yung isa pong miyembro ay wala po.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: And we have the minutes to prove so, na yun lamang po dapat talaga yung mga naroon.

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: So in short, Madam Speaker, distinguished colleague,

segments.speaker: Rep. Rommel Rico T. Angara
segments.text: yung board po mismo yun nandun. And siguro, you just don't take my word for it.

segments.text: Kanina nga po, I've asked permission from the good secretariat, tandaan po natin yung

segments.text: yung dapat yung pag nagdi-desisyon na

segments.text: is because we are willing to do so.

segments.text: Yan po ay may para at least to appease everybody.

segments.text: At the same time, para ipakita

segments.text: na kami ang Department of Labor and Employment

segments.text: ay walang tinatago at the same time

segments.text: o maging ganap na wage order

segments.text: to be implemented on September 26 of this year.
